links.comparator_used: General-purpose ChatGPT5.2 baseline without instruction configuration
links.outcome: Patient-facing communication quality (total 20-point rubric score covering readability, disclaimers, practicality, empathy, structure)
links.effect: Mean total rubric score 17.95 ± 1.62 for CSA-GPT vs 9.55 ± 1.94 for ChatGPT5.2 (p < 0.001; Cohen's d = 3.22). Practicality, empathetic tone and structural clarity were all higher for CSA-GPT (all p < 0.001). Major factual errors: 1.25% vs 3.75% (p = 0.25).
links.quote: In this exploratory proof-of-concept study, instruction configuration improved the patient-facing communication quality of LLM responses in cosmetic dentistry across readability, practicality, empathetic tone, structural clarity, and safety boundary-setting, without increasing major factual errors.

design_hint: instruction configuration with mandatory disclaimers and reading-level constraints
